Amit Mishra Joins Delhi Capitals Coaching Staff for IPL 2027

Former India cricketer Amit Mishra has joined the Delhi Capitals coaching staff for the upcoming IPL 2027 season. He will be part of a coaching team that includes Sourav Ganguly, Yuvraj Singh, and Shane Bond.
